review_candidates.title: Systemförvaltare till Bup Stockholm
review_candidates.description: Vill du vara del i en verksamhet som gör skillnad för barn och ungdomar? Tycker du om att arbeta med digitalisering? BUP Stockholm söker en systemförvaltare på heltid. BUP Stockholm erbjuder specialiserad psykiatrisk vård för barn och ungdomar från 0 till 17 år inom Stockholms län. Vi är en del av Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde som är en vårdgivare inom Region Stockholm. Tillsammans är vi inom BUP cirka 1 200 anställda som varje år möter drygt 25 000 barn, ungdomar och deras familjer. BUP Stockholm arbetar aktivt med att utveckla vården. Vi har en stark digitaliseringsutveckling inom vården och ett nytt journalsystem är på gång. Vi behöver fler medarbetare som vill arbeta med detta. Vi behöver en Handläggare IT med inriktning mot systemförvaltning som är en del i vårt växande team. Vi söker en medarbetare som har engagemang i och vana av förvaltningsarbete inom verksamhetsstöd och IT. Du tycker om utvecklingsarbete och digitalisering. Tjänsten finns inom BUP Stockholms verksamhetsstöd och på enheten BUP Systemförvaltning, uppföljning och kommunikation. Arbetsuppgifter Du är en del av ett team som arbetar med systemförvaltning och utveckling inom enheten. Som systemförvaltare arbetar du med lokal systemförvaltning inom BUP vilket innebär stöd till verksamheten vid användning av verksamhetens vårdsystem, som t ex journalsystemet TakeCare och patientadministrativa systemet Pastill. Du stödjer chefer och lokala superanvändare i hur systemen ska användas inom BUP. Du samarbetar med leverantörer och SLSO/Regionen i förvaltningsfrågor. I din roll arbetar du med support, rapportering av buggar, och problemlösning. Du arbetar aktivt med utbildning och vid behov håller du i utbildning ute i verksamheten. Du tar fram mallar, instruktioner och handböcker. Ser till att systemförvaltningens rutiner är uppdaterade. Kvalifikationer Utbildning inom administration eller något vårdyrke. Erfarenhet av att arbeta administrativt i TakeCare motsvarande LSA, systemförvaltare eller IT-samordnare. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med administrering av IT-system i vården. Goda allmänna IT-kunskaper. Minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet. Det är meriterande med följande: Erfarenhet av arbete i offentlig förvaltning Erfarenhet av arbete inom vården Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett verksamhetsstöd Erfarenhet av att arbeta med Alltid öppet som administratör. God kunskap om vårt patientadministrativa system Pastill Personliga egenskaper Du ska ha en god social förmåga, har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och ingå i team. Du är initiativtagande och självgående. Du är flexibel och har en god arbetskapacitet. Du har ett bra sinne för ordning och reda och tycker om administration. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Vi erbjuder BUP skapar goda förutsättningar för att du som medarbetare ska utvecklas och bli riktigt bra inom din profession. Som medarbetare har du förmåner såsom fri sjukvård, extra ersättning vid föräldraledighet, möjlighet till löneväxling, avtalspension samt försäkringar. Vi erbjuder också flexibla arbetstider samt friskvårdsersättning (5000 kr per år). Anställningsform Tjänsten är en tillsvidaretjänst på heltid. Tillträde efter överenskommelse. Anställningen kan inledas med 6 månaders provanställning om prövobehov finns. Övrigt Intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningsperioden. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering, enligt gällande regelverk. Vid patientnära arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde: - tillämpas registerkontroll före beslut om anställning enligt SLSO:s övergripande anvisning för registerkontroll vid anställning. - ska medarbetare som kommer att ha patientkontakt genomgå nyanställningsundersökning, enligt gällande direktiv, vilket sker genom företagshälsovården innan anställning. - krävs, förutom svensk yrkeslegitimation, goda kunskaper i svenska språket motsvarande nivå C1 enligt den gemensamma europeiska referensramen (GERS). Samma krav är vägledande vad gäller icke-legitimerad personal med patientkontakt. Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde (SLSO) är en av Sveriges största vårdgivare med 11 600 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder hälso- och sjukvård i Region Stockholms regi inom psykiatri, primärvård, geriatrik, ASIH, närakuter, somatisk specialistvård, habilitering och hälsa samt hjälpmedel. I samverkan med Karolinska Institutet bedriver vi forskning, utbildning och utveckling. Läs mer om SLSO här. Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen. Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss i Region Stockholm

LinkedIn, email & B2B digital content • Develop and adapt visual content for LinkedIn and other professional platforms — the primary B2B channel. • Design LinkedIn newsletter illustrations and creatives. • Design email campaign graphics and layouts (headers, banners, templates, and supporting visuals). • Create digital campaign creatives from awareness through lead generation, including variations for testing when needed. Research-led design • Understand the content type and idea behind each request, then create a design that is genuinely relevant to it — not just visually finished. • Research and apply each destination platform's technical criteria before delivering: correct file format, ideal dimensions / aspect ratio, and resolution for where the asset will be published. • Take ownership of getting specifications right so assets render correctly on their target platform, without repeated rework. AI-assisted design • Understand and stay current with recent AI design and video tools, and actively use them to produce better work faster. • Apply AI tools appropriately across the workflow (ideation, drafting, asset generation, editing, and short-form motion) while maintaining brand quality and consistency. Light motion & short-form video • Produce short-form motion graphics and simple animations — typically 1–3 minute social videos / reels — as a regular part of the role. • This is a required capability, scoped to social-ready motion rather than heavy or broadcast-level production. Brand consistency • Apply and safeguard brand colours, typography, and layout structure across all outputs. • Proactively identify and correct visual inconsistencies; keep the style coherent across posts and campaigns. Collaboration & workflow • Work closely with the Marketing and Business Development teams to turn concepts and briefs into impactful designs. • Coordinate day-to-day with the Digital Marketing Supervisor on priorities and scheduling. • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines without compromising quality; raise timeline or resourcing risks early. Continuous improvement & production discipline • Stay current with design, motion, AI, and social-media trends to keep content fresh and relevant. • Maintain organised files, correct export formats and sizes, and proper version control. Requirements • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Media, Fine / Applied Arts, or a related field. • 3–5 years of professional design experience (agency or in-house). • Strong portfolio showcasing diverse work — infographics, digital / social, branding, and some short-form motion / video. • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), plus working ability in After Effects and / or Premiere Pro for short-form motion. • Practical proficiency with current AI design / video tools (e.g., Firefly, Midjourney, Veo, or equivalent) and the judgment to apply them effectively. • Ability to research briefs and platform requirements independently — interpreting content intent and sourcing the correct format, sizing, and resolution per platform. • Comfortable designing in both Arabic and English (bilingual typography and layout). • Experience creating LinkedIn, email, and digital campaign designs (preferred). • Ability to adapt design styles across different industries. • Excellent multitasking, time management, and attention to detail. • Strong communication and collaboration skills. Preferred • B2B, HR / recruitment, or professional-services design experience is a strong advantage; otherwise, a demonstrated ability to design in a professional, corporate tone suitable for a B2B audience. Additional Assets (Nice to Have) • Photography or basic video shooting.

review_candidates.description: Job Type Full-time Description Nemean Solutions, headquartered in Sierra Vista, AZ, is a certified SBA 8(a) Native Hawaiian Organization (NHO) and veteran-operated company providing advanced Military Intelligence, Enterprise and Cloud IT services, Cybersecurity, Special Operations Forces (SOF) Exercise and Training, and niche Program Support and Professional Services to Federal and State Agencies supporting the US Government Defense, Intelligence and Aerospace sectors. This position is being posted for a potential government contract opportunity. Job Overview The Executive Receptionist provides executive-level reception, administrative, guest-service, and secure conference room support for classified meetings at the White House Campus. The position supports senior Government leaders and officials by coordinating schedules and meeting spaces, greeting and directing participants, managing correspondence and calls, maintaining access control and physical security, and protecting classified and confidential information in accordance with WHSR procedures. This position is contingent upon contract award, Government approval as Key Personnel, successful completion of required security onboarding, and availability of funding. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Provide polished VIP guest services by greeting, welcoming, and directing high-profile clients, visitors, senior Government leaders, and meeting participants. Support secure, executive-level meetings involving the President, Vice President, National Security Advisor, senior White House personnel, and other Government leaders. Manage secure conference room scheduling, verify bookings, provide access, direct participant flow, and coordinate meeting setup with other Executive Assistants. Manage and screen telephone calls, emails, correspondence, mail, and deliveries related to the conference room space in a professional executive-level manner. Anticipate executive and meeting requirements and address needs proactively, efficiently, and discreetly. Monitor and maintain the physical security and access control of White House secure conference facilities, coordinating with security staff as necessary. Manage conference rooms in accordance with protocols for executive-level meetings and WHSR Standard Operating Procedures. Maintain the reception area and manage office and conference support supplies, materials, inventory, and meeting name plates. Manage and control classified documents efficiently and in accordance with all security protocols. Analyze, develop, and review program administrative operating procedures. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all executive and classified matters and comply with NDA, onboarding, professional appearance, and conduct requirements. Provide mission-critical and surge support when workload exceeds baseline staffing capacity, including extended-hour, holiday, emergency, and potential 24-hour coverage as directed. Competencies Exceptional judgment, professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. Executive-level customer service and stakeholder communication. Strong oral, written, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills. Ability to multitask, anticipate needs, and perform under pressure in a fast-paced, changing environment. Professional and working proficiency in reading, writing, speaking, and understanding English. Executive calendar, conference room, correspondence, reception, and office administration support. Secure-facility access control and careful handling of classified documents. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, office equipment, and the ability to learn stand-alone applications. Requirements Minimum Requirements: At least three years of experience supporting senior executives in a high-level corporate, executive-office, White House, military, intelligence-community, or C-Suite Government environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to become proficient in stand-alone applications. Ability to work on-site during core operations, Monday through Friday from 0600 to 1800, and provide two hours of on-call service on a 24/7 basis upon Government notification. Ability to support a typical 40-hour workweek and remain available for mission-essential, emergency, weather-emergency, surge, extended-hour, holiday, and potential 24-hour coverage requirements. Ability to work under pressure in a complex and changing executive environment. Security Requirement Top Secret/SCI clearance and access are required. Employment is subject to favorable EOP Security Office approval, National Security Council onboarding/screening, and ongoing compliance with continuous evaluation, security, and nondisclosure requirements. review_candidates.title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCC Communities
review_candidates.description: Description Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently. Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role. NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position. Key job responsibilities Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS) Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA) Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment Technical writing to support change management program Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations. Role may support more than one location/site. Physical Requirements Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs. A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment. About The Team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. Basic Qualifications High school or equivalent diploma 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of data center engineering experience Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits. As part of this evolution, Council has created the position of Chief Information Officer to provide dedicated strategic leadership across technology, digital enablement, cybersecurity, data and information management. With significant technology initiatives already underway and an opportunity to establish a clear long-term digital direction, this is a rare opportunity to help shape how technology enables the organisation and the services it provides to the community. About The Role Reporting to the Director Customer and Corporate Services, the Chief Information Officer will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Council’s technology, digital enablement, cybersecurity, data governance and information management functions. This is far more than an ICT operations role. Council is seeking a strategic, contemporary and people-focused leader who can establish a clear technology direction, strengthen organisational capability and translate technology investment into tangible improvements for the organisation and community. With a major Core Systems program already underway, you will provide leadership across Council’s evolving technology environment while developing the strategy, governance and future priorities required to strengthen digital maturity longer term. You will work closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Councillors and leaders across the organisation to identify priorities, develop compelling business cases and build organisational understanding of where investment in technology can deliver the greatest value. Leading a multidisciplinary function, you will oversee ICT operations, enterprise systems, cybersecurity, information governance and digital initiatives, while supporting a capable existing technical team with the leadership, direction and organisational influence required to succeed. Importantly, you will have the opportunity to shape the journey ahead, establishing the strategic foundations, strengthening governance and helping Council move from maintaining technology to using it as an enabler of better organisational performance and customer outcomes. About You You are an accomplished senior leader with experience across technology, digital transformation, enterprise systems or a related environment within a complex organisation. Your experience includes leading transformation and change, influencing senior stakeholders and developing the strategies and business cases required to support major investment decisions. Politically aware and commercially astute, you build credibility quickly and are equally comfortable engaging with technical specialists, executives and non-technical stakeholders. Most importantly, you are an authentic and collaborative leader who can provide clarity through change, empower an established team and help Baw Baw Shire Council build a secure, contemporary and sustainable technology environment for the future.
